purpose: Freeze candidate selection and gates before reading new-fragment outcomes
new_fragment_selection: Stable common groups at quarter, three-quarter, and final available index; exclude original fragment 17; deduplicate
interpretation: Exploratory fixed thresholds, not calibrated probabilities. Replicated events count once per source-time cluster (within 0.1 seconds). Event detector and all outcome metrics remain fixed. No events means unvalidated, never successful. Keep failed gates and adverse events in the report. Separate signal/sensitivity gates from target validation to quantify whether reference-only gates predict failure. Even outcome pass needs event identity/provenance and speech listening review.
